date_selection: Receipt date and previous Gregorian calendar date, at most two dates per event. A previous date may be a non-session: an empty response is missing evidence, never backfilled by a fabricated session or nearby arbitrary snapshot. Exact date/market calls must be finalized and approved after official API identity/access inspection.

decisions.blocked: Separate unavailable API/key/service, historical date not supplied, issuer/security conflict, security-change-history missing, halt/action/session missing. No failure is NO_ALPHA.
decisions.nulls: Unobserved fields, publication timestamps and costs per verified event remain NULL; hypothetical fixtures never count as market evidence.
decisions.price_pilot: At least five verified historical mappings from three companies, then-market evidence and safe relevant correction lineage. Propose at most three by frozen rank only. Never automatically authorize prices.

evidence_rules.CORPORATE_IDENTITY_VERIFIED: Rehash original XML and explicit AREGCIK match to source corporation.
evidence_rules.CORP_STOCK_LINK_VERIFIED: Contemporaneous DART source six-digit code candidate plus matching historical KRX security, date, market, corporate issuer/name corroboration and listing chronology; corporate ID/name alone insufficient. Ambiguity, rename/merger/transfer/multiple-class conflict quarantined unless independently resolved.
evidence_rules.HISTORICAL_SECURITY_PRESENT: Actual successful dated KRX basic response with exact approved basDd, valid distinct standard and short codes, market and stock type. Current snapshots never prove historical existence.
evidence_rules.PRICE_AND_SESSION_PENDING: No new prices here; independent subsequent gate.
evidence_rules.THEN_LISTED_STATUS_VERIFIED: Historical security evidence and LIST_DD<=event date, explicit matching market. Does not imply session tradability.

sampling: DF008 confirmed original cohort only. Three per year 2022/2023/2024/2025; ascending original frozen rank within year; skip any previously selected corporation across years. No price/PnL selection, no substitutions after KRX results.
scope: Historical security basics only. Daily price API documentation can be researched, but no price requests. No KIS or new DART authentication, key issuance, accounts, orders, cancels or LIVE.
